getRestaurantMenu.description: Primary menu fetch API – default inStock=false (returns ALL items)

fetchMenu.description: Secondary fetch API – default inStock=true (returns ONLY in-stock items)

addMenuItem.description: Create a new menu item with auto-computed fields

updateMenuItem.description: Update menu item with isCustomizable recomputation

deleteMenuItem.description: Delete a menu item – NO cascade delete

updateMenuItemAvailability.description: Toggle isInStock flag – Quick stock toggle endpoint

getAllMenuItems.description: Fetch all menu items for a restaurant

getMenuItemById.description: Fetch single menu item by ID

getMenuItemsByCategory.description: Fetch menu items filtered by category

getAllCategories.description: Fetch categories ordered by order field

updateMenuItemStock.description: Update isInStock field for a menu item

searchMenu.description: Search menu items by name prefix

getOrder.description: Retrieve order by ID or by table

updateCartStatus.description: Update status of cart within an order (kitchen workflow)

getActiveOrdersForRestaurant.description: Get all active orders for kitchen/server dashboard

createOrUpdateOrder.description: Creates new order or appends cart to existing (called by checkoutCart)

updateMenuItemStatus.description: Update individual item status within order (chef-side)

ORDER_COMPLETED Notification.description: Push notification sent to server when order completed

validateTableAndLocation.description: Validate table access via QR scan and location

checkTableStatus.description: Get table status and details for consumer app

cleanupInactiveSessions.description: Clean up stale sessions and reset inactive tables

generateTableOTP.description: Generate new OTP for a table

updateTableStatus.description: Update table status (clear table, disable, etc.)

getTablesForRestaurant.description: Get all tables for server app list view

getTableDetails.description: Get detailed table info including recent orders

createOrGetTableSession.description: Create new or retrieve existing session for a table
createOrGetTableSession.sampleResponse:
{
  "id": "sess_b1_001",
  "tableId": "table1",
  "primaryUserId": "1234567890",
  "users": ["1234567890"],
  "status": "active",
  "createdAt": Timestamp,
  "updatedAt": Timestamp,
  "expiresAt": Date     // 4 hours from creation
}

endTableSessions.description: End active session for a table

updateCustomerVisit.description: Record new visit for authenticated customer

endCustomerVisit.description: End current visit and update table status

createOrUpdateCustomerProfileDirect.description: Direct customer profile update (used by validateOTP)

getCart.description: Retrieve cart contents for a table

addItemToCart.description: Add menu item to cart with variants/addons

removeItemFromCart.description: Decrement quantity or remove item from cart

checkoutCart.description: Convert cart to order and clear cart
checkoutCart.sampleResponse:
{
                        "status": "success",
                        "message": "Checkout
                            completed successfully.",

clearCart.description: Delete entire cart for a table
